'''Èric de las Heras Izquierdo''' (born 13 January 2002) is an Andorran footballer who plays as a [[midfielder]] and [[Midfielder#Winger|right winger]] for {{Spanish football updater|Socuéllamos}} side [[UD Socuéllamos]] and the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]].

==Club career==
De las Heras joined the youth teams of [[Gimnàstic de Tarragona]] when he was a child.<ref name="U17">{{cite web |title=Eric de las Heras, al preeuropeo sub-17 con Andorra |url=https://gimnasticdetarragona.cat/es/eric-de-las-heras-al-preeuropeu-sub-17-amb-andorra/ |website=Gimnàstic de Tarragona SAD |access-date=6 May 2026 |language=es-ES |date=25 October 2018}}</ref> In 2021, he joined Romanian [[Liga III]] side [[CS Pandurii Târgu Jiu|Pandurii Târgu Jiu]], but his season was ruled over in April 2022, following an injury.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Pasăre |first1=Cătălin |title=Victorie cu Lupac și ,,tunurile” pe Deva: Avem şanse mici, dar nu cedăm |url=https://www.gorjeanul.ro/victorie-cu-lupac-si-tunurile-pe-deva-avem-sanse-mici-dar-nu-cedam/ |website=Ştiri locale de ultima ora, stiri video - Ştiri Gorjeanul.ro |access-date=7 May 2026 |language=ro-RO |date=11 April 2022 |trans-title=Victory with Lupac and the "cannons" on Deva: We have small chances, but we don't give up}}</ref> In September 2022, shortly before Pandurii Târgu Jiu dissolved, he joined [[Primera Catalana]] side [[Reus FC Reddis]].<ref>{{cite web |title=El Reus FC Reddis comença l'aventura a Primera Catalana |url=https://reusdigital.cat/noticies/esports/el-reus-fc-reddis-comenca-laventura-primera-catalana |website=Reusdigital.cat diari de Reus. Notícies i actualitat del Camp de Tarragona |access-date=6 May 2026 |language=ca |date=20 April 2023 |trans-title=Reus FC Reddis begins its adventure in the Primera Catalana}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Èric de las Heras signa pel Reus FC Redis |url=https://www.diariandorra.ad/esports/220929/eric-las-heras-signa-pel-reus-redis_114142.html |website=Diari d'Andorra |language=ca |date=29 September 2022 |trans-title=Èric de las Heras signs for Reus FC Redis}}</ref>

In 2023, he signed for [[Tercera Federación]] side [[CDJ Tamarite]].<ref name="NFT"/>{{bsn|date=May 2026}} In July 2026, he signed for [[UD Socuéllamos]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Eric de las Heras fitxa pel Socuéllamos de Tercera RFEF |url=https://www.diariandorra.ad/esports/260721/eric-heras-fitxa-pel-socuellamos-tercera-rfef_200903.html |website=[[Diari d'Andorra]] |access-date=1 August 2026 |language=ca |date=21 July 2026}}</ref>

==International career==
De las Heras played for Andorra at youth level, making his debut with the [[Andorra national under-17 football team|under-17s]] in 2018.<ref name="U17"/> He made 24 appearances for the [[Andorra national under-21 football team|under-21 national team]] between 2019 and 2024, scoring his only goal against [[Malta national under-21 football team|Malta]],<ref>{{cite web |title=Malta supera Andorra en un partit amistós |url=https://www.rtva.ad/ca/esports/futbol/malta-supera-andorra-partit-amistos |website=RTVA |access-date=6 May 2026 |language=ca |date=24 November 2022 |trans-title=Malta beats Andorra in a friendly match}}</ref> and serving as the team's captain.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Rodrigues |first1=Víctor |title=Eloy Casals: “Volíem competir i fer un bon partit; ho hem aconseguit” |url=https://www.andorraesportiu.com/eloy-casals-voliem-competir-i-fer-un-bon-partit-i-ho-hem-aconseguit/ |website=Andorra Esportiu |access-date=6 May 2026 |language=ca |date=15 October 2024 |trans-title=Eloy Casals: “We wanted to compete and have a good game; we achieved it”}}</ref>

He was first called up for the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]] by [[Koldo Álvarez]] in September 2024.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Duaso |first1=Víctor |title=Dos debutants a la llista |url=https://www.bondia.ad/esports/dos-debutants-a-la-llista |website=www.bondia.ad |access-date=6 May 2026 |language=ca |date=3 September 2024 |trans-title=Two newcomers on the list}}</ref> He went on to make his debut on 10 September, in a 1–0 defeat against [[Malta national football team|Malta]] in [[2024–25 UEFA Nations League D|League D of the 2024–25 UEFA Nations League]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Rodrigues |first1=Víctor |title=Berto Rosas: “Hem d’estar molt orgullosos del treball fet” |url=https://www.andorraesportiu.com/berto-rosas-hem-destar-molt-orgullosos-del-treball-fet/ |website=Andorra Esportiu |access-date=6 May 2026 |language=ca |date=10 September 2024 |trans-title=Berto Rosas: “We should be very proud of the work done”}}</ref> In total, he has made 11 appearances for the Andorra national team.<ref name="NFT">{{cite web |last1=Strack-Zimmermann |first1=Benjamin |title=Eric Izquierdo (Player) |url=https://www.national-football-teams.com/player/95801/Eric_Izquierdo.html |website=www.national-football-teams.com |access-date=6 May 2026 |language=en}}</ref>
